source_title: India squad for Men’s U-19 Asia Cup: Aaryavir Sehwag, Anvay Dravid included; Lakshya Raichandani to lead - Sportstar
source_excerpt: Chennai Aaryavir Sehwag and Anvay Dravid have been named in India’ squad for the Men’s Under-19 Asia Cup set to take place in Muscat from November 5 to 14. Lakshya Raichandani will lead a 15-member squad, while Yashbhardan Singh Chauhan will serve as vice-captain. As many as 13 players from the squad for the recent Australia Under-19 white-ball series have been included in the Asia Cup squad. Aryan Savsani and Ishan Sood are the only new faces in the squad. India will enter the competition high on confidence, after having registered a 3-0 clean sweep against Australia. India is part of Group A alongside Pakistan, Nepal and UAE. Group B comprises Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Afghanistan and Malaysia. The top two teams from each group will advance to the semifinals. The final will take place on Saturday, November 14.
